name: uptime-monitor
description: Sentinel — uptime monitor. Root scripts to run the whole stack.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && node scripts/bootstrap-env.js
scripts.db:shell: docker exec -it sentinel-mongo mongosh -u sentinel -p sentinel-local-dev --authenticationDatabase admin uptime
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm run db:up && npm run dev
